file:///tmp/demo-site/index.html.text: Your cozy corner on the harbor Small-batch roasts, brewed with love Welcome to Harbor & Bean! We're a family-run coffee house pouring delicious small-batch roasts every morning. Come relax, bring a friend, and enjoy the warmest welcome in Seaside. Our favorites Harbor Latte — $4.50 Sea Salt Caramel Espresso — $5.00 Blueberry Morning Pastry — $3.25 Visit us Open Mon–Fri 7am–5pm, Sat–Sun 8am–2pm. Find us at 42 Harbor Lane, Seaside. Call (555) 123-4567 or email hello@harborandbean.example. What our neighbors say The friendliest staff and the best latte in town. Cozy atmosphere, I'm here every morning! — Maya R. Fresh pastries, great coffee, wonderful service. A true neighborhood gem. — Daniel K.

file:///tmp/demo-site/about.html.text: About Us | Harbor & Bean Coffee House Our story Harbor & Bean was founded in 2019 by the Alvarez family. Our mission is to be the warmest gathering place in Seaside — great coffee, honest prices, everybody welcome. Our values: community first, quality without pretense, and sustainability in every cup.

file:///tmp/demo-site/faq.html.text: FAQ | Harbor & Bean Coffee House Frequently asked questions Do you offer catering? Yes! We cater events of 20+ people with 48 hours notice. Do you have wifi? Free wifi for all guests, no purchase necessary.

file:///tmp/demo-site/policies.html.text: Policies | Harbor & Bean Coffee House Our policies Returns & refunds If you're not happy with your drink, we'll remake it on the spot — no questions asked. For catering orders, cancellations made 48 hours in advance receive a full refund. Privacy We never sell your personal information. Loyalty program emails are opt-in only.
